sourceDescription: Needle Spotify tweak by Renzo. QR share, playlist cloner, queue long-press, Regram-style Settings, 30 themes, Car mode, Turntable, Album wall, Rating, Forgotten favorites, lockscreen art enlargement and more.

appRepositories.appDescription:
Spotify with Needle tweak.
Keeps the original com.spotify.client bundle, best match for system integrations.
Install over the real Spotify (delete the Needle-bundled one first if you already had it).

Recent: Regram-style Settings, 30 themes, Playlist cloner, Queue long-press, Recognize redesign.

Spotify with Needle tweak.
Uses the com.needle.spotify bundle so Gbox updates in place without deleting.
Lockscreen Now Playing tap does not open the app on this bundle.
